mentions.name: neverbreak.ai
mentions.description: An AI tool that fixes failing CI and opens pull requests with proof. It reproduces the failure, applies a fix, and re-runs the tests in a fresh environment to confirm they pass before opening a PR — if the test doesn't actually pass, no PR is opened. Each PR includes a short GIF of the fix working. Supports C, Python, Go, Node.js, and Java on GitHub Actions and GitLab CI, and is currently in beta.
mentions.problem: Most "AI CI fix" tools just read the error log and guess a patch, without verifying that the fix actually works.
mentions.audience: Currently in beta with a few users; works on GitHub Actions and GitLab CI for teams whose CI builds fail.
